title: Practice event type for Single Race and split screen
summary: Single Race and split-screen Race gain an Event row (Single Race / Practice), matching the original game's Practice race type (PR #472, closes #449). Practice is offered on every race course with the same CPU field as Single Race, no lap limit (Laps shows N/A), lap times every lap, and no finish, results, records or points.
details: Behavior was established from the exact USA v2.00 build; evidence is in research/RACING.md. A new browser test rides a Sausalito lap against 3 CPUs.
limitation: Split-screen Practice is covered by a unit test only. Copy ride link drops the event type (#473). Duel and Lap Attack are still to come (#451).
